description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5330006145764 SEAL,PLAIN ENCASED: Line 0001 Qty 263 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0098 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The term of the contract/order will be one year or until the aggregate total of orders placed against the contract/order reach 350000.00. The estimated number of orders per year is 11. The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 39. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots. Approved sources are 80201 533404-14; 97499 214-040-826-001. The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice. Hard copies of this solicitation are not available. Specifications, plans, or drawings are not available. All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
